**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 12.1 License, p0149).**

- **Issue:** The grant is "nonexclusive, **revocable**" to "Customer" only — revocable at IBM's discretion (walk-away territory), with no coverage of Affiliates or Subcontractors. § 14.17 forecloses any implied path to add them.
- **Partial mitigation:** § 14.10 allows assignment to an M&A successor, so only the transfer limb of the fallback is met; the affiliate/contractor and revocability limbs fail.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** extends the grant to Customer's Affiliates and Subcontractors acting on its behalf, replaces at-will revocability with revocation only via termination for cause under § 3.3, and confirms successor transfer under § 14.10. Fallback (Affiliates on written notice) offered in the comment.
